editorial:
A genius dog named Mr. Peabody adopts a human boy named Sherman, and together they travel through time in a machine called the WABAC. This 2014 animated adventure takes that classic setup and turns it into a big, colorful family movie. The story kicks off when Sherman shows off the time machine to a classmate named Penny, and the two accidentally mess up history. Suddenly, Mr. Peabody has to chase them across different eras to fix the timeline before everything falls apart. It is fast, funny, and packed with silly historical jokes that kids and adults can both enjoy.

The animation looks great, especially the time-travel sequences, and the voice cast brings a lot of charm to the characters. The humor mixes smart wordplay with goofy slapstick, so there is something for everyone. On the downside, the story can feel a little busy, and some of the historical gags fly by too quickly. Still, it is a sweet movie about family and learning to trust each other. If you want a fun night in, stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: In the final act, Sherman and Penny's time meddling creates a huge rip in space-time that threatens to erase history. Mr. Peabody gets hurt trying to fix it, and Sherman has to step up and save his dad. The timeline is restored, and the social worker who wanted to take Sherman away changes her mind after seeing their bond. The movie ends with the family back together, ready for their next adventure through time.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves animated family adventures and time-travel stories.
